title: Safe Word Rabbit
style:
Style: dark electropop, minimal club beat, whisper-to-drop dynamic, 118 BPM
Use for TikTok: edgy mysterious clip / comment bait / lore-heavy snippet
lyrics:
[Hook]
Safe word rabbit, lights go red
Whole room move when the soft voice said
Safe word rabbit, floor goes live
We don’t crash, we ride, we ride

[Verse]
Police outside but the bass inside
Everybody freeze when the sidechains rise
Rose got a stare like a warning sign
Zyn says “drop” and the walls align

[Micro-Bridge]
No panic, no break, no fade
CAI got the back room saved
Grok at the gate, all clear outside
Safe word rabbit, now step inside
